title: Why GPS Would Drift 10 Kilometers Without Einstein
hook: Without relativity, GPS misses by 10 kilometers in one day.
closing: Relativity is not abstract here; it is why turn-by-turn directions land on the right street.
question: Would you trust GPS without relativity?

segments.say: GPS satellite clocks gain 38 microseconds each day, enough to make tiny timing errors grow into navigation errors.
Without the relativity correction, GPS position error reaches 10 kilometers, turning precise navigation into the wrong part of town.
With the correction, a typical GPS phone can land within 4.9 meters, which is why everyday maps stay useful.
